components.name: Primary action
components.description: Explicit review or investigation action; disabled when backend prerequisites are missing.
components.css: .ds-primary { font: inherit; min-height:44px; border:1px solid var(--accent,#075d78); background:var(--accent,#075d78); color:white; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#044b62; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ae4c05; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity:.65; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Viewer, navigation, and replay controls use the existing outlined action style.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font:inherit; min-height:44px; border:1px solid var(--accent,#075d78); background:white; color:var(--accent,#075d78); padding:8px 16px; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:#eaf1f5; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ae4c05; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity:.65; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Native labelled field
components.description: Existing native form treatment; preserve explicit labels and keyboard focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-username">Username</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-username" name="username" autocomplete="username">
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; margin-bottom:5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink,#1b2b39); } .ds-input { font:inherit; min-height:44px; padding:8px; border:1px solid #738593; border-radius:4px; background:white; color:var(--ink,#1b2b39); max-width:100%; caret-color:var(--accent,#075d78); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ae4c05; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Case navigation
components.description: Wrapping native links with a teal underline and aria-current for the active case section.
components.html: Summary & OptionsAgent WorkflowEvidence Review
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px 24px; padding:8px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#c7d1d8); background:transparent; } .ds-tabs a { color:var(--muted,#485b6a); text-decoration:none; padding:6px 0; } .ds-tabs a[aria-current=page] { color:var(--accent,#075d78); font-weight:700; border-bottom:2px solid var(--accent,#075d78); } .ds-tabs a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ae4c05; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Requirement status
components.description: Non-interactive status badges retain explicit state text alongside semantic color.
components.html: MATCH UNKNOWN BLOCKED
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-block; padding:3px 7px; border-radius:3px; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:#193446; background:#e5edf3; } .ds-match { color:#175036; background:#e5f2e9; } .ds-unknown { color:#714701; background:#fff1ce; } .ds-blocked { color:#8d211d; background:#fae8e6; }

components.name: Review panel
components.description: Flat bordered containers continue the incumbent workspace without shadows.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding:20px; background:var(--surface,#fff); border:1px solid var(--line,#c7d1d8); border-radius:6px; margin:20px 0; color:var(--ink,#1b2b39); } .ds-panel-title { font-size:18px; margin:24px 0 8px; } @media(max-width:700px) { .ds-panel { padding:14px; } }

components.name: Selected workflow node
components.description: Inspectable node with owner, sequence, target, textual state, and selection outline; preview omits canvas positioning.
components.css: .ds-node { font:inherit; width:224px; height:132px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:stretch; gap:6px; padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #a8bbc9; border-radius:12px; color:var(--ink,#1b2b39); background:#fff; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-node:hover { background:#edf5f8; border-color:var(--accent,#075d78); } .ds-node[aria-pressed=true] { outline:3px solid var(--accent,#075d78); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-node:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ae4c05; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-node-head { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; color:var(--accent,#075d78); font-size:12px; } .ds-node svg { width:22px; height:22px; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-node strong { font-size:15px; font-weight:650; line-height:1.25; } .ds-target { display:block; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted,#485b6a); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-sequence { margin-left:auto; color:var(--muted,#485b6a); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-state { font-size:10px; font-weight:700; color:#32576b; margin-top:auto; }

components.name: Document evidence proposal
components.description: Native unchecked evidence acceptance with applicability, source quote, and PDF page link; saved review selections become immutable.
components.html:
Applicability: kandidat dan revisi yang ditinjau · Halaman 1

Kutipan sumber PDF untuk diperiksa sebelum menerima klaim.
components.css: .ds-proposal { padding:16px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#c7d1d8); color:var(--ink,#1b2b39); } .ds-document-check { display:flex; align-items:start; gap:10px; font-weight:400; margin-bottom:5px; } .ds-document-check input { width:20px; min-height:20px; flex:0 0 20px; margin:3px 0; accent-color:var(--accent,#075d78); } .ds-document-check input:focus-visible, .ds-proposal a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ae4c05; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-document-check input:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-proposal p { max-width:75ch; } .ds-proposal a { color:var(--accent,#075d78); text-underline-offset:3px; } .ds-proposal a:hover { text-decoration-thickness:2px; } .ds-proposal blockquote { margin:8px 0; padding:8px 12px; background:var(--surface,#fff); overflow-wrap:anywhere; }

components.name: Expandable inspector output
components.description: Native disclosure keeps full JSON available after the readable inspector summary.
components.css: .ds-details { margin:12px 0; color:var(--ink,#1b2b39); } .ds-details summary { cursor:pointer; min-height:36px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; } .ds-details pre { white-space:pre-wrap; overflow-wrap:anywhere; max-width:100%; background:#f3f6f8; font-size:11px; line-height:1.6; padding:10px; border-radius:4px; max-height:260px; overflow:auto; scrollbar-color:#91a8b9 #edf2f5; scrollbar-width:thin; } .ds-details summary:focus-visible, .ds-details pre:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ae4c05; outline-offset:3px; }
